screenshots.caption: The actual installed application presents independently authenticated bundle inventory and retained policy evidence.
The installed review view keeps candidate eligibility and deployment context separate from activation; complete signed evidence remains downloadable.

observedTests.name: Independent distribution
observedTests.observed: Downloaded provider assets, sidecar and installed file identities matched. The complete installed app was used; installation resources remained byte-identical.

observedTests.name: Actual app use and restart
observedTests.observed: Ten actual workflows and ten complete evidence bundles passed the original installed consumer, including negative cases, no-overwrite export and two normal exits with exact retained history.

observedTests.name: Source and security
observedTests.observed: All current main workflows passed before publication. All configured exact-source processed CodeQL categories had zero raw findings and zero open alerts.

observedTests.name: Individual shortcut
observedTests.observed: Desktop and Start-menu targets were read back against the installed version. Normal default-profile shortcut activation is separate from full installed executable acceptance.
